title: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.37651v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in multi-turn agentic workloads that require sustained interaction with complex environments. Existing reflective prompt optimizers such as GEPA learn from failed rollouts, but agentic failures can also come from prompt weaknesses, harness limitations, stochastic execution, or noisy judges. We argue that such failures may not provide useful learning signal, and may even be harmful; and thus it is essential to curate which tasks are provided to the prompt optimizer for better performance. We introduce GEPA-Curator, a framework that augments the prompt optimizer to select which agent experiences should shape prompt optimization. translated_title: GEPA-Curator：面向自我改进智能体的精选学习
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于需要与复杂环境持续交互的多轮智能体工作负载中。现有的反思式提示优化器（如GEPA）从失败的执行轨迹中学习，但智能体的失败也可能源于提示词的弱点、测试框架的局限、随机性执行或带有噪声的评判器。我们认为，这类失败可能无法提供有用的学习信号，甚至可能是有害的；因此，为了获得更好的性能，必须对提供给提示优化器的任务进行精心筛选。我们提出了GEPA-Curator，这是一个增强提示优化器的框架，用于选择哪些智能体经验应当参与塑造提示优化。具体而言，GEPA-Curator包含两个组件：任务筛选，用于过滤掉那些可能提供噪声或不可靠学习信号的任务；以及先验成功检索，为某个任务有选择性地检索过去成功的轨迹……
tldr: 提出GEPA-Curator框架，通过任务筛选与先验成功检索两个组件来精选用于提示优化的智能体经验，过滤噪声和不可靠的学习信号，从而提升自我改进智能体的性能。
en_tdlr: GEPA-Curator is a framework that enhances prompt optimization for self-improving agents by curating agent experiences through task curation and prior success retrieval, filtering out noisy or unreliable learning signals to achieve better performance.
